_readme: The reinvestment ladder (owner's intent 2026-11-15; rules in playbook/DOMAIN-SETUP.md "Budget plan" and "Reinvestment ladder", and playbook/STATE.md owner decisions). upgrades.js reads it; learn.js shows it in insights.md. Claude never buys, pays or signs up for anything: it only says when a rung is funded and safe, and logs what the owner reports buying (node upgrades.js bought <id> --amount <paid>). Rungs are checked in this order, and money for a rung that is ready or funded-but-blocked is set aside before the next rung is checked, so two rungs never both look affordable out of the same money. costUSD is the planning price; the owner logs what was actually paid. Unknown keys in a `when` block stop the whole ladder (a typo there could loosen a rule).
_when: money: "collected" = funded once collected money covers the cost (the settled first-upgrade rule, no cushion); "available" = funded once (collected x settings.reinvestShare - everything in data/spend.jsonl - money set aside for earlier rungs) - cost >= settings.upgradeCushionUSD. costSetting: read the cost from that setting when set. after + afterDays: the earlier rung must have been bought at least that many days ago (one new inbox a month). healthy: every sending inbox passes `health` below over its window. pauseOnComplaint: any spam complaint in the last health.complaintPauseDays days pauses the rung. requires: settings.<setting> must equal `equals`, otherwise the rung shows funded but blocked with `blocked`. minInboxes: at least this many sending inboxes bought. trigger "bankShort": only needed while the prospect bank cannot keep up (data/bank.json under data/bank-state.json `low` for lowDays days; bank.js records no dates yet, so today's count is used).

health._health: Read from the same data the send governor in learn.js uses: pitched emails in data/outcomes.jsonl in the last windowDays days, the bounced and stop events for those businesses, complaint events, and data/send-state.json throttleUntil. Healthy = bounces under 3% and STOPs under 5% for every inbox (events carry an `inbox` field once multi-inbox sending is built; until then all sends are one inbox), at least minEmails sent in the window (a quiet month proves nothing), and the governor not cutting back.
